product.description: Monoprice™13‑in‑1 USB‑C® Triple Display Universal Docking Station with DisplayLink®Universal Docking with Seamless Multi‑Device Connectivity for Up to Three Displays, Featuring Up to 10Gbps Data Transfer, Robust Charging, and Broad Compatibility in an All‑in‑One Workstation HubExperience unparalleled connectivity and productivity with the Monoprice 13‑in‑1 USB‑C Triple Display Universal Docking Station. Built for professionals and power users alike, this advanced docking station seamlessly transforms a single USB‑C or USB‑A port into a comprehensive workstation hub, enabling effortless expansion for video, data, audio, Ethernet, and power needs‑all from one sleek device.Harnessing advanced DisplayPort Alt Mode and DisplayLink technology, this dock allows you to connect up to three displays simultaneously with impressive resolution‑perfect for managing complex workflows or enjoying immersive entertainment. The main HDMI output delivers sharp visuals up to 4K, while the two additional outputs support either HDMI or DisplayPort with resolutions up to 2560 x 1440. Thanks to its integrated DisplayLink chipset, it works seamlessly with Windows, macOS (including M1 & M2 Macs), Android, Chrome OS, and Ubuntu devices. Whether you’re expanding a laptop or desktop setup, this dock easily adapts to the evolving needs of your workspace.The 13‑in‑1 design includes five high‑speed USB ports‑including USB‑C and USB‑A Gen 2 with 10Gbps data transfer‑to accelerate file transfers and power essential devices. A 2.5Gbps RJ45 Ethernet port provides ultra‑fast and stable networking, while the integrated 3.5mm audio port supports crystal‑clear music playback and voice calls. Powering your setup is simplified with a robust 150W DC power adapter that delivers up to 96W of host charging to keep your laptop running strong.Monoprice prioritizes safety and convenience with built‑in protections, secure lock slots (Standard and Nano), and intuitive controls. The docking station's durable construction withstands daily use, and comprehensive safety guidelines ensure reliable and worry‑free operation. Each package includes a premium USB‑C cable and everything you need to get started. For peace of mind, Monoprice backs the product with dedicated customer service, technical support, and a one‑year limited warranty‑because performance should never come at the expense of support.Meet
